faq.q: How do I install Sonic Dash on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Sonic Dash and check the developer is SEGA before tapping Install. It needs Android 7.1 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from SEGA and may be altered, so the safest way to play Sonic Dash is the official listing.

faq.q: Is Sonic Dash safe for kids?
faq.a: Yes. Sonic Dash is rated Everyone with mild fantasy violence and has no chat with strangers. It shows ads and sells red rings and characters, so turn on purchase authentication for children.
Yes, it's free to play with ads. Optional in-app purchases from $0.99 to $99.99 buy red rings, characters and bundles.

faq.a: The latest update adds Riders Metal Sonic as a new legendary character.
